info.name: Didit Verification Case Management API
info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

request.description: Apply one explicit action to the case subject. Supply a unique client_reference to obtain an action receipt and make retries idempotent. Reusing that reference with a different payload returns 409. With a reference, inspect receipt.status even when HTTP status is 200: FAILED means no action was applied. Repeating a failed request does not execute it again unless retry is true. Omitting client_reference preserves the legacy response.

request.description: Confirm the exact signed preview within 15 minutes. Only fixed templates and an OTP-verified contact belonging to the case subject are accepted. The request ID makes retries idempotent. Delivery is queued; SENT, SIMULATED and UNKNOWN are distinct outcomes. An actionable request sets the case to Awaiting user. A review update leaves its status unchanged.

request.description: Access one customer request using its request-specific token. No private case findings, original identity data or recipient address are returned. Actionable requests expire after seven days. Cancellation or case resolution invalidates the link. Responses are immutable and remain evidence for reviewer assessment; they never approve or update a source verification.
